title: Organic Aromas Recalls Wintergreen Essential Oil Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirements; Risk of Poisoning (Recall Alert)
summary: The product contains the substance methyl salicylate which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). The packaging of the product is not child resistant, posing a risk of poisoning if the contents are swallowed by young children. Units: About 300

title: Residential Elevators Recalls Elevators Due to Impact Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The elevator cab can rise unexpectedly to the top of the elevator shaft and abruptly stop, posing an impact hazard to any occupants in the elevator cab. Units: About 6,300.

title: Cycling Sports Group Recalls Front Racks for Cannondale Treadwell Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The recalled front racks on the bicycles can detach and cause the bicycle's front wheel to abruptly stop, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 1,975 (In addition, about 114 were sold in Canada).

title: Royal Gourmet Recalls Deluxe Gas Grills Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Wayfair.com
summary: The grill's plastic regulator hose can melt and catch fire, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,100.

title: WHILL Recalls WHILL Personal Electric Vehicles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
summary: The vehicle's control pad can malfunction causing the power to turn on/off and the speed to increase/decrease, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: About 1,160.

title: CFMOTO Recalls Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The fuel line fitting on the vehicles can fail to securely lock onto the fuel injector inlet. This can allow fuel to spill onto the hot engine parts and ignite, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 500.

title: Decathlon USA Recalls Swiss Balls Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled exercise balls can unexpectedly burst, causing the user to fall to the floor, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 510.

title: SODA SENSE Recalls CO2 Canisters Due To Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: A valve in the canister can break, allowing CO2 to forcefully eject the top valve, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 19,200.

title: StoreYourBoard.com Recalls Hi-Lift Storage Hoists Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The green straps can break while the Hi-Lift Storage Hoist is in use, causing whatever object was being stored in the hoist to fall, posing an injury hazard to passersby. Units: About 36,700 (In addition, about 250 were sold in Canada).

title: Advantus Recalls Fluorescent Computer Task Lamps Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The tape used to contain wire components within the lamps case housing can overheat and melt, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 384.

title: Hanamint Recalls Swivel Rockers, Club Swivel Rockers and Club Swivel Gliders Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The chair's post can separate from base, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 12,000.

title: IMMI Recalls Harnesses Made for Polaris, Can-Am, and Kawasaki UTVs Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The harness can be missing stitching, posing an injury hazard to the occupant by failing to properly restrain them in the event of a crash. Units: About 162,000.

title: CFMOTO Recalls Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The throttle gas pedal can fail to return quickly to the idle position which can create a crash hazard if the vehicle does not slow down as quickly as expected by the driver when the gas pedal is released. title: The Vitamin Shoppe Recalls Vthrive Bioactive Multivitamins Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning (Recall Alert)
summary: The multivitamins' packaging is not child resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The capsules inside the bottle contain iron, which can cause serious injury or death to young children if multiple tablets are ingested at once. Units: About 8,200.

title: Caravan Global Recalls Chairs Due to Fall and Injury Hazards; Sold Exclusively at H-E-B Stores
summary: The chair's plastic bracket can bend or fail, and cause the fabric seat to rip apart from the frame, posing fall and injury hazards to the user. Units: About 2,700.

title: Kobalt Cordless Electric Chainsaws Sold Exclusively at Lowe's Stores Recalled Due to Laceration Hazard; Distributed by Hongkong Sun Rise Trading
summary: The chainsaw can remain in the "on" position, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 150,000 (In addition, about 1,400 were sold in Canada).

title: Kobalt Cordless Electric Pole Saws Sold Exclusively at Lowe's Stores Recalled Due to Laceration Hazard; Distributed by Hongkong Sun Rise Trading
summary: The switch on the recalled pole saws can fail while under a heavy load, and cause the unit to continue running after the user releases the trigger, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 106,400 (In addition, 120 in Canada).

title: Pedego Recalls Electric Bikes Due to Fall Hazard
summary: An improperly manufactured electrical cable can cause the bicycle to accelerate unexpectedly, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 11,600.

title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Sirrus Bicycles with Alloy Cranks Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The crank arm can disengage and cause the bicycle's rider to lose control, posing fall and injury hazards. Units: About 36,000 in the United States and 3,200 in Canada.

title: Monoprice Recalls Ethernet Cables Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The cables do not meet the flammability requirements of the UL 1666 voluntary safety standard, posing a fire hazard when the cable is exposed to a flame. Units: About 10,800.

title: MWE Investments Recalls Westinghouse Portable Generators Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The recalled portable generators can leak fuel, posing a fire and burn hazard. Units: About 7,500.

title: RH Recalls Industrial Three-Panel Mirrors Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The mirror panels can become loose, detach from the backing and fall, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 270.

title: Petzl Recalls Safety Ropes Due to Fall and Injury Hazard
summary: The rope can have a deep cut or tape securing two ends of rope together, which can cause the rope to fail, posing fall and injury hazards to the user. Units: About 14,850 (In addition, about 2,500 were sold in Canada).

title: STIHL Recalls to Repair Mini-Cultivator Attachments Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The gearbox could have mistakenly been installed upside down by the STIHL dealer causing the tines to rotate backwards toward the operator, posing a laceration hazard to the user. Units: About 185,000.
